name: [Kuroinu Gaiden] In'yoku no Daishoukan
source:
The Seven Shield Alliance was once formed to oppose the vicious Dark Elven Queen Olga.
The nation of desire - the nation of service - was founded by swallowing all its allies, including the High Elves, the beautiful knights, the priestesses of the Eastern Kingdom, and the Dark Elven Queen, who was the main culprit.

"All women who belong to the nation are obligated to perform sexual service."

As the founding declaration of the nation proclaimed, every woman in the Nation of Service was to be subjected to and responded to every desire of men.
Rumors of this attracted men from all over the continent, and the nation of service became very prosperous.

Then, half a year after the founding of the nation.
Six months after its establishment, Volt, the king of the Service Nation, gave his chief of staff, Keane, an order "The prostitute who will become the symbol of the Service Nation will be the king's daughter.

Create a brothel that will become the symbol of the Service Nation.

Upon receiving the king's order, Keane immediately sets out to gather women to serve as prostitutes.

[Edited from DMM Games]
translation:
七盾联盟曾经是为了对抗邪恶的黑暗精灵女王奥尔加而成立的。
欲望之国——服务之国——是通过吞噬所有盟友而建立的，其中包括高等精灵、美丽的骑士、东方王国的女祭司，以及罪魁祸首的黑暗精灵女王。

“所有属于国家的妇女都有义务提供性服务。”

正如建国宣言所宣称的那样，服务国家中的每一位女性都必须服从并回应男性的每一个愿望。
此事的传言吸引了整个大陆的男人，服务之国变得非常繁荣。

然后，建国半年后。
服务国成立六个月后，服务国国王伏特向他的幕僚长基恩下达命令：“成为服务国象征的妓女将是国王的女儿。

创建一家妓院，使其成为服务国家的象征。

接到国王的命令后，基恩立即着手招募妇女充当妓女。”
